svg.title: ACT inference pipeline on the NexArm
svg.desc: Each 480 by 640 camera frame goes through a shared ResNet18 to a 512 by 15 by 20 feature map, a 1 by 1 convolution and a fixed 2D sine position code, giving 300 tokens per camera; the joint state and the style latent z, which is zero at inference, become two more tokens; four post-norm encoder layers mix all 902 tokens; one decoder layer turns 100 zero-initialised query slots with learned positions into 100 actions through self-attention, cross-attention and a feed-forward block; a linear layer gives 100 by 6 normalised actions that the arm runs in full before observing again.
svg.text: ACT turns one look into 100 actions.

g.text: 480 × 640 RGB · ImageNet mean / std · V = 2 or 3
dataset mean and std, per joint
in training it comes from the CVAE
ACT does not read the task text
one backbone for all cameras · FrozenBatchNorm · lr 1e-5
2D sine position p: 256 for y, 256 for x · fixed
1D tokens get learned positions; image tokens keep their 2D sine code
P is added to the queries and keys of every attention in the encoder,
and to the keys of the decoder's cross-attention, never to the values
cross-attn · k = M + P, v = M
queries are x + pdec​ in both attentions
after the 100th action: new frames, next cycle
100 actions at 30 Hz = 3.33 s without new observations
